clues.it: Rosa era nella 4ª colonna, nella 1ª riga e a nord di Tea.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 4th column, in the 1st row and north of Tea.

clues.it: Carla era nella 11ª colonna e nella 2ª riga, ma non era accanto a un serbatoio.
clues.en: Carla was in the 11th column and in the 2nd row, but was not beside a fuel tank.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 9ª colonna, a ovest di Carla e nell'Hangar.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 9th column, west of Carla and in the Hangar.

clues.it: Sergio era su un fascio di cavi, accanto a una poltrona e nella stessa stanza di Tea.
clues.en: Sergio was on a cable bundle, beside a flight seat and in the same room as Tea.

clues.it: Vito era nella 5ª riga e accanto a una perdita di refrigerante.
clues.en: Vito was in the 5th row and beside a coolant spill.

clues.it: Tea era nella 6ª riga e su un fascio di cavi, ma non era accanto a una grata.
clues.en: Tea was in the 6th row and on a cable bundle, but was not beside a floor grate.

clues.it: Marta era accanto a un droide e nella stessa stanza di Tea.
clues.en: Marta was beside a droid and in the same room as Tea.

clues.it: Elena era nella 10ª colonna, nella 8ª riga e a ovest di Carla.
clues.en: Elena was in the 10th column, in the 8th row and west of Carla.

clues.it: Giada era nella 6ª colonna, accanto a una perdita di refrigerante e nel Criosonno.
clues.en: Giada was in the 6th column, beside a coolant spill and in the Cryo Bay.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Ugo era nella stessa stanza di Elena.
clues.en: Ugo was in the same room as Elena.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Rosa lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 4ª.

steps.it: Carla può stare solo nella 2ª riga: escludendola, a Paolo resta una sola casella: riga 3ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Carla can only be in the 2nd row: ruling it out leaves Paolo a single square: row 3rd, column 9th.

steps.en: Tea can only be in the 6th row: ruling it out leaves Sergio a single square: row 4th, column 3rd.
